objective: Verified reliability and useful shipped improvements

web-dependency-run.expected_when: An owned feasible card, due commitment or scheduled deliverable exists. A blocked due commitment remains expected.
web-dependency-run.acceptance: A prepared package or verified external receipt meets the card acceptance check; distinguish prepared, released and observed live.
web-dependency-run.fallback: Diagnose a recurring defect, prepare a scoped fix or document a reproducible technical handoff with an acceptance test. Respect dirty working trees.
web-dependency-run.recovery: Reconcile external receipts and current release before resuming. Hold ambiguous effects.

web-guardrail-review.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
web-guardrail-review.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
web-guardrail-review.fallback: Review existing experiments; distinguish missing measurement from insufficient evidence and measured effects. Prepare a smaller test when evidence cannot mature.
web-guardrail-review.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
